logs.title: Handover
logs.text:
To whoever has the desk next: the lights are on a timer, the timer is wrong, don't fix the timer.
Water is Tuesday. The door sticks, lift and then push.
If the knocking starts on the lower deck, it is the pipes. It has always been the pipes.
I am going to check the pipes now.

logs.title: For Marl
logs.text:
If you're reading this you've found me before the others have, and that's lucky, or it isn't.
The card's in my left boot. The red door is not a door.
I am sorry about the smell.
Tell Marl it was the pipe and not the drink. She'll know.

logs.title: Wake for Tusk
logs.text:
Wake for Tusk, who owed everyone and was owed by no one.
Menu: the good stew, the other stew, a cask nobody has labelled.
Speeches limited to one minute, by order of Ma. Hobb spoke for forty. Nobody stopped him.
The cask was empty by the end, and so was everything else.

logs.title: Air budget, day 31
logs.text:
Nine of us, six hours of scrubber. We did the sums twice. Then we did them again in a nicer way, for the children, and the sums came out the same.
Odd thing is the quiet has made us kinder.
Brin gave me her last ration bar and said she wasn't hungry. She was lying and so was I.

logs.title: What the glass does
logs.text:
The glass doesn't sing when you listen. It sings when you stop.
We have started to stop on purpose.
There is a prayer in it somewhere, or a fault in the lattice, and the difference, the Prism says, is a matter of what you were hoping for.

logs.title: Tool roster
logs.text:
Hammer, Pell, back by lunch.
Cutter, Pell, back by lunch.
Torque wrench, Aun, back by end of shift.
Torque wrench, Aun, back by end of shift.
Torque wrench, Aun, back by end of shift.
The hook by the door is for the pry bar. Leave it on the hook. I mean it.

logs.title: Handover, night shift
logs.text:
For whoever has the desk next. Pump three sounds worse than it is. It has always sounded like that.
Coffee in the second drawer. The mug is mine, the other mug is also mine.
If anything strange happens, do nothing heroic. Call the number on the wall.
I have just noticed the number on the wall is my own.

logs.title: Names, by card
logs.text:
Card 0114, Aldous. Card 0115, Meret. Card 0120, Tobias, who always forgets his.
Twelve cards at the start of the week. Nine on the fourth day. By the end, four.
Card 0131 is Odette. She typed her own name in the notes field, in capitals, in case anyone should ever need it.
Let it be recorded that she went in last, and that she held the door.

logs.title: Return to sender
logs.text:
Dear Lenka, the weather is fine here. The hydroponics did well. Your brother's ship is late but they say it always is.
Dear Mr. Haught, your parcel has been received and kept dry.
Dear whoever: this is a reply to a letter that never came. I think it said that you were fine. I am glad you are fine. The weather is fine here too.
